title: Factorized layer × expert Tucker address
hypothesis: A layer factor multiplied by a compact Mirror expert address generalizes to held-out layer-expert combinations with less storage than flat Tucker coefficients; generic free factorization and independent matrices are controls.
physical_object: shared bank of K=8 orthonormal 8×8 matrices
mirror_coordinate: shared expert vector with per-expert Givens angle; layer×expert coefficients are A[layer] ⊙ m[expert]
controls: flat Tucker coefficient per layer-expert pair, missing combos set to zero
generic free layer factor × expert factor
Mirror layer factor × Givens expert address

development.selection_metric: held-out combination output NRMSE, actual total bytes and matrix error

paid_objects: full matrices or flat coefficients or layer/expert factors
storage.heldout: all missing combination coefficient values are inferred from factors; held-out labels are not encoded

success_gate: Aligned held-out output NRMSE <=0.05 and at least 20% fewer bytes than generic free factorization; independent factor stratum tests private expert-coordinate boundary.
failure_gate: Mirror fails held-out combinations or misses byte/quality gate; generic free factorization matching Mirror means no Mirror-specific result.
boundaries: Synthetic coefficient tensor and linear matrices only
Coefficient factors are extracted from observed combinations by anchored ratios
Aligned teacher expert factor is generated by the same Givens orbit
No trained MoE router or language-model quality
